description: The power of expansion; the society will expand their borders through war, conquest, exploration, population growth, or alliance with other societies. Taking control of land that is owned by others or not at all. Founding new settlements, integrating into old settlements or conquering them. Forming kingdoms and empires.
fantasticalDescription: The power of fantastical expansion; magical conquests, divine expansion, etc.
